title: Aircrew 1939-1945
memorial_details: Tree planted in the grounds of St Faith's Crematorium. a Dedicatory tablet bearing the RAF Crest and inscription in white, and a Dedicatory plaque with raised lettering in white on a black background.
inscription: DEDICATORY TABLET: TO HONOUR THE MEMORY OF THOSE / WHO FLEW AND LOST THEIR LIVES IN / THE WAR OF 1939-1945 / "LEST WE FORGET" DEDICATORY PLAQUE: THIS TREE WAS DEDICATED BY/ THE AIRCREW ASSOCIATION/ NORWICH AND DISTRICT BRANCH/ TO HONOUR ALL COMRADES/ WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES/ WE WILL/ REMEMBER THEM
community_connection: Dedicated by the Aircrew Association, Norwich and District Branch to honour all comrades who gave their lives.
